4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4"></path><path d="M21 14H11"></path><path d="m15 10-4 4 4 4"></path></svg></span><span>复制全文</span></button></div><h1 class="group min-w-0 text-4xl font-medium leading-tight mb-8 text-foreground" id="goal">目标模式<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">面对需要跑很久的复杂任务，可以用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/goal</code> 给当前会话设一个目标。设定之后，ZCode Agent 会围绕这个目标持续推进：每一轮结束都会自动校验目标是否达成，没达成就自己接着下一轮，确认完成才收尾——把「盯着 Agent 反复说继续」变成「设一个目标，等结果」。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">下面这个研究任务已经连续跑了二十轮，右侧摘要面板里能看到每一轮做了什么、当前进行到哪一步。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260731-goal/goal-summary-panel-annotated.webp" alt="目标摘要面板：目标与已用时间、按迭代分组的清单项，以及当前这轮的进度与待办" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">适合什么任务</strong>：一句话说得清、但要多轮才能做完的活，例如——</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">「重构整个模块并保持测试通过」</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">「修复所有 TypeScript 编译错误」</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">「把这个页面的 Lighthouse 性能分提到 90 以上」</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">目标描述越具体、越可校验，每轮的判断就越准。比起「优化一下性能」，「把 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">pnpm test</code> 跑通，并且首屏加载控制在 2 秒内」这样的说法效果会好很多。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="goal-commands">设定目标<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在输入框里输入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/goal</code>，后面接一句话，就是这轮会话的目标。也可以先输入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/</code>，在建议面板里选 goal。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260731-goal/goal-set-command-annotated.webp" alt="在输入框输入 /goal，建议面板中高亮「查看或设定当前会话目标」" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">一个会话同一时间只有一个目标。常用写法：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-text">/goal                   查看当前目标
/goal &lt;目标描述&gt;        设定目标；已经有目标时会替换掉它
/goal replace &lt;目标&gt;    明确替换当前目标
/goal pause             暂停
/goal resume            恢复
/goal clear             清除
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">目标设定后，摘要面板会出现目标卡片，显示目标描述和已用时间。下面按迭代分组，列出每一轮做完的清单项；最下方是当前这一轮的进度和待办。每轮的标题来自上一轮校验给出的下一步动作，所以顺着往下看，就是这个任务一路是怎么推进的。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">一件小事值得知道：清单项归属于它第一次出现的那一轮，哪怕是在后面几轮才做完，也仍然显示在原来那一组里。这样回头看每轮的实际产出才不会错位。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="goal-verification">每轮自动校验<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">一轮结束后，ZCode 会单独做一次校验，判断目标有没有达成。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">没达成时，会给出下一步该做什么，并自动开启下一轮——不需要你手动追问「继续」。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260731-goal/goal-verification-continue-annotated.webp" alt="对话流中出现「第 18 次迭代 · 目标未完成，任务继续」的分隔线，下面自动接上第 19 轮" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">达成时才会收尾，输出总结。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260731-goal/goal-verification-complete-annotated.webp" alt="对话流中出现「第 20 次迭代 · 目标已完成，任务结束」的分隔线，下面是收尾总结" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">校验看的是实据。写了一份计划、列了一份待办清单、跑了很久，或者给出一段听起来很像结论的回复，这些本身都不算数；要有改出来的文件、命令输出、测试结果这类能核对的东西才算。另外，只要还有待办没做完，校验就不会判定完成，而是优先把它做完。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="goal-control">中途介入<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">目标设定后随时可以调整。最省事的办法是直接用自然语言告诉 Agent 你的想法——换个方向、先停一下、这个目标不要了，它会据此替换、暂停或清除，不用记命令格式。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260731-goal/goal-paused-annotated.webp" alt="执行 /goal pause 后，目标进入暂停，记录与产物都保留" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">暂停不会丢东西：已经跑过的轮次、工具调用记录和产出的文件都在，摘要面板顶部的图标会变成继续，随时可以接着跑。中途按停止键取消任务时，目标也会自动暂停，不会在你没留意的时候继续消耗额度。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">关掉会话再打开也一样。目标状态由系统保存，重新进入这个会话时它还在，可以从上次的地方继续。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">目标会在三种情况下停止自动推进：校验判定完成、你主动暂停或清除、以及跑到为这个目标配置的用量上限。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="goal-limits">什么情况下设不了目标<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">有两种情况会被拦下来，界面上会直接说明原因。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260731-goal/goal-blocked-cases.webp" alt="计划模式下提示「Goal 无法在 Plan 模式下使用，请切换模式」；任务运行中提示「请结束任务后设定目标」" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">计划模式专注于先把方案讨论清楚，不会自动往下执行，所以和目标模式的自动续跑是冲突的，需要先切回其他执行模式。任务正在跑的时候也设不了目标，等这一轮跑完，或者先按停止。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="goal-with-modes">与执行模式搭配<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">目标模式和 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/agents#modes">执行模式</a> 管的是两件事：目标决定「做到什么程度才算完」，执行模式决定「过程中多少操作需要你确认」。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">长目标任务建议搭配 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">完全访问</strong> 或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">自动编辑</strong>，中途打断少，迭代会更连贯。反过来，如果这个任务会改动重要文件，用 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">变更前确认</strong> 也没问题，只是需要你在旁边盯着确认。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
